name: Joint Special Meeting of the Urban Forest Advisory Committee and the Environmental Commission
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Joint Special Meeting of the Urban Forest Advisory Committee and the Environmental Commission
AGENDA
NOVEMBER 4, 2025 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL Environmental Commission: Commission Chair Cramer, Commission Vice Chair O’Connor, Commissioners Switzler, Parker, Wick, and Bruner.
Urban Forestry Advisory Committee: Committee Chair Lefkowits, Committee Vice Chair Schneider, Committee Members Michelove, Altman, Gurnoe, Palumbo, and Jenne.
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
5.
ACTION ITEMS
1.
Review and provide comments to City staff on the draft native plant ordinance, Sara Cadona, Senior Planner
Recommend that the Environmental Commission and Urban Forestry Advisory Committee (UFAC) provide City staff with any comments or recommended modifications for staff's consideration.
Item 5A - Draft Native Plant Ordinance Staff Report
Item 5A Attachment 1 - Draft Native Plant Ordinance
6.
ADJOURNMENT
